edits.new:
```gherkin
Scenario: AC5 Where the title documents are not found, the case stays at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED and a task re-creates the title set before the release, inside 5 working days (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED
    When the title documents are not found
    Then the case stays at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED
    Then a task re-creates the title set before the release, inside 5 working days

Scenario: AC6 The decision record carries the rule and its version, and it is written with the state change in one transaction (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case state change decided by a rule in the rule package in force
    When the state change is written
    Then the decision record carries the rule and its version
    Then the record and the state change are written in one transaction

Scenario: AC7 The booking and the settled balance are confirmed from the ACE account data for the next business date (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a booking and a settled balance for account "A-0001"
    When the rwb-source-data contract fake returns the ACE account data for the next business date
    Then the booking and the settled balance are confirmed from that data

Scenario: AC8 A consumed event that is delivered again is processed once, and the redelivery does not repeat the state change or the release request (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed event that has been processed
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the state change is not repeated
    Then the release request is not repeated

Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the case at its current state and the case does not move to COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case that has not yet moved to COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED
    When a consumed call fails or does not answer
    Then the case stays at its current state
    Then the case does not move to COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED

Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused and the case state is unchanged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case at its current state
    When a status change the model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused
    Then the case state is unchanged
```
